title: Cross-functional engineering staff narrative — July 6 2027
content:
Meeting purpose: weekly cross-team leadership huddle to align priorities across serving runtime, observability, platform engineering, and private deployments. Focus this week: a) capacity headroom for Q3 launch, b) rollout cadence for 2.5 runtime, c) incident response readiness for long-tail p99 failures.

Attendees: Anita Chen (owner), Ethan Park, Priya Nair, Diego Morales, Rachael Kim, Omar Haddad, + observers from product-hosted-api (joined for first 15m).

Agenda (fast cadence):
- Quick metrics snapshot (2m)
- Team updates (3m each)
- Blockers & escalations (10m)
- Decisions + rollouts (7m)
- Action items & owners (3m)

Quick metrics snapshot:
- Cluster utilization (us-west): 72% avg daily, burst days to 86% (Tue peak).
- Median gen latency across 2.4 models: 68ms; p99 now 1.4s (improved from 1.9s last week after kernel patch).
- Cost per 1k tokens (internal metric): down 6% week-over-week from batching improvements.
- Open incidents: 1 active (INF-1399) — degraded shard handshake causing ~0.5% request errors on warm-up traffic.

Team updates (high-level):
- Serving-runtime (Anita): kernel selection changes deployed to canary yesterday. Early telemetry shows stable mem usage but one unexpected regression on 4k seqs in quantized path. We rolled back quantized tuning for gqa model variant; follow-up hotfix targeted EOD. Planning: freeze canary for 24h before expanding.

- Observability (Priya): added a short-lived flamegraph capture for p99 traces; retention 7d. Dashboard card for "kv-cache misses by route" created — link in linked artifacts. Request: serving-runtime to add lightweight tag on requests that hit fallback routes for easier filtering.

- Platform-engineering (Ethan): autoscaler policy v3 staged in staging; expected to reduce cold-starts by ~30%. Need to coordinate a maintenance window for scaling policy rollout to prod (requested weekend 7/10). Also flagged capacity-aware allocation conflict with Dedicated pools — see INF-1284.

- Private Deployments / Solutions Eng (Diego): two customers planning on-prem evals mid-July — need an air-gapped checklist and support plan. Diego will produce a one-pager for SRE/SE by 7/8.

- Product (Rachael, 15m join): readiness checks for Hosted API feature flags: wants canary split 10/90 once kernel patch stabilizes. Emphasized business need to keep error rate <0.2% for canary cohort.

Blockers & escalations (detailed):
- INF-1399 (active incident): degraded shard handshake on high parallelism workloads. Owner: Omar. Current mitigation: shift traffic away from affected node pools; long-term: handshake timeout tuning + small protocol change. Escalation: if rollback to previous runtime is needed, need a runbook (action item below).

- Quantized path regression (serving-runtime): regression observed for 4k sequences in gqa-quant variant. Owner: Anita. Hotfix targeted; if not resolved in 24h, will revert quantized variant for any traffic >2k seqs.

- Autoscaler maintenance conflict: platform-engineering's proposed weekend rollout conflicts with a Dedicated capacity customer's maintenance window. Owner: Ethan. Short-term: propose sliding rollout to Sunday night 02:00->06:00 to avoid overlap.

Decisions made (bullet):
- Hold canary expansion for kernel selection until 24h stable telemetry across seq buckets (decision by Anita + Priya).
- Approve weekend rollout window provisional: Sunday 02:00–06:00 (pending final confirmation from sales/CS).
- Create a minimal rollback runbook for runtime rollbacks; must be reviewed by SRE + release-eng before next canary expansion.

Action items (owner — due):
- Anita: ship hotfix for quantized 4k regression, test on canary by 2027-07-07 EOD.
- Omar: full postmortem skeleton for INF-1399 and a short-run mitigation plan; initial draft 2027-07-07 morning.
- Ethan: confirm Dedicated customer window and update rollout calendar; coordinate with sales by 2027-07-08.
- Priya: add fallback-route tag to observability events (lightweight header); deliver PR request + CLA by 2027-07-08.
- Diego: on-prem checklist one-pager for SE/SRE; deliver 2027-07-08.
- Rachael: prepare canary cohort criteria doc (error thresholds and observability gates) and share to linked Confluence page by 2027-07-07.

Risks & notes to watch:
- If p99 remains >1.2s after kernel patch expansion, product may pause new feature launches — need contingency comms.
- Batching improvements reduce cost but push memory pressure on 8xA100 nodes during tall-request bursts; platform to monitor long-tail mem spikes.
- Observability retention changes are okay short-term but we must keep 30d for legal/audit traces — Priya to confirm retention policy doesn't drop audit-level traces.

Parking lot / follow-ups not discussed due to time:
- Revisit KV cache eviction policies for multimodal workloads (add to next week's agenda).
- Cross-team tabletop incident drill scheduling for July end (owner: SRE, suggested dates 7/26–7/30).

Meeting wrap:
- Next sync: 2027-07-13 — format: same time, focus: post-rollout telemetry and incident playbook review.
- Quick wins: platform to confirm rollout window; Anita + Priya to validate canary telemetry tags.

Freeform notes (informal):
- "Notes to self" from Anita: consider toggling prefix-cache aggressive expiry during warm-up traffic to reduce handshake churn — prototype after hotfix.
- Slack callouts: folks chimed in on #runtime-ops with short-term ideas; thread link above.
- Unresolved Q: who signs off on rollback for Hosted API canaries (Product PM or platform lead)? Rachael to confirm authority model by next week.

End of notes.

---
Document history: draft taken in-meeting by Anita, edited 7/7 with action item clarifications.
